Definition: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food:--scrip.
BiblicalUsage: Pera is a scrip, a leather wallet for food on a journey. Jesus told the Twelve to take nothing for their journey — neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money — and to go with only a staff.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the empty scrip is the point: God's messengers travel light because He provides on the way.
